run_uroman_cli_standalone: run the uroman CLI tool to convert text from an input file to romanized output
uromanize: create a function that takes a list of text strings and returns romanized text using uroman
get_uroman_commands: build a list of shell commands to run uroman with a specified language code
get_uroman_executable_path: get the path to the uroman perl executable downloading it if needed
UromanPreprocessModule_run: run the UromanPreprocessModule to uromanize an input file and return the output path
